item.title: By: Michael A. Lewis
item.dc:creator: Michael A. Lewis
item.description:
But wait, when I eat a full meal, I get tired. I call it "food coma." Then when I go for a walk, the food coma lifts and I feel energetic.
Then again, when i eat less and exercise more, I lose weight. That doesn't require belief.
I think I'll just eat and walk.
item.content:encoded:
But wait, when I eat a full meal, I get tired. I call it “food coma.” Then when I go for a walk, the food coma lifts and I feel energetic.

Then again, when i eat less and exercise more, I lose weight. That doesn’t require belief.

I think I’ll just eat and walk.
